nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the project-management domain crate; declares the lineage, orchestrator, projects, and sync public modules that together own project/work-item storage, workflow orchestration, code lineage tracking, and pluggable sync.

nodes.name: analytics.rs
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed analytics queries that summarize which files, functions, and commits an AI chat session touched, powering the session-impact view.

nodes.name: commit_tracker.rs
nodes.summary: Matches a git commit's diff hunks against previously recorded provenance entries by line-range overlap and records the association in commit_lineage.

nodes.name: event_hook.rs
nodes.summary: Parses AI coding-tool events (edits, patches, appends) to resolve the line ranges they touched, before handing them off to provenance recording; also parses unified-diff patch text into per-file hunks.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled patch/hunk-header parsing (parse_hunk_header, count_patch_content_lines) instead of a diff library, tailored to the specific patch dialects emitted by coding agents.

nodes.name: git_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Defines diff data types (LineageHunk/LineageFileDiff/LineageCommitDiff) and a OnceCell registration slot letting the git integration layer inject a get_commit_diff implementation without project-management depending on it directly.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a OnceCell-based registration slot to invert the dependency on the git_api crate and avoid a circular crate dependency.

nodes.name: hashing.rs
nodes.summary: Computes a normalized SHA-256 hash of a code node's content (whitespace-collapsed per line) used to detect unchanged provenance entries.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for lineage tracking; declares the analytics/commit_tracker/event_hook/git_bridge/hashing/provenance/schema submodules and exposes async wrappers around their blocking SQLite calls.

nodes.name: provenance.rs
nodes.summary: Records a node_provenance row for an AI-session edit, hashing the touched content and attributing any tree-sitter symbols whose line range overlaps the edit.

nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Creates the node_provenance and commit_lineage SQLite tables (with supporting indexes) used by the lineage-tracking subsystem.

nodes.name: branch_health.rs
nodes.summary: Runs git subprocess checks (branch existence, working-tree cleanliness, merge conflicts) to determine whether a work item's branch is safe to resume.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command facade for the work-item orchestrator: starts/cancels/retries orchestration runs, reports status, creates follow-ups, and surfaces diff stats and PR state to the frontend.

nodes.name: diff_stats.rs
nodes.summary: Computes added/removed/renamed file statistics between a work item's branch and its base branch by parsing `git diff --numstat` output.

nodes.name: follow_up.rs
nodes.summary: Creates a new follow-up work item linked to a parent work item, carrying forward review feedback so a fix session can be launched.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel declaring the orchestrator's branch_health/commands/diff_stats/follow_up/proof_of_work/recovery/state_machine submodules that together implement the SDE -> Review -> Follow-up workflow.

nodes.name: proof_of_work.rs
nodes.summary: Small mutator helpers that record an agent session's branch, accumulated cost/tokens, PR link, review outcome, diff stats, and review feedback onto a work item's proof-of-work frontmatter.

nodes.name: get_provenance_session_ids
nodes.summary: Queries distinct session_id values from node_provenance, returning every chat session that has recorded lineage.

nodes.name: get_session_impact
nodes.summary: Aggregates a session's touched files, created functions, influenced commits, total attributed lines, and first/last timestamps into a SessionImpact summary.

nodes.name: SessionImpact
nodes.summary: Summary record of a chat session's impact: files touched, functions created, commits influenced, total lines attributed, and edit/commit timestamps. Serialized to the frontend session-impact view.

nodes.name: FunctionEntry
nodes.summary: Row shape for a function-level provenance entry: file, name, node type, and line range.

nodes.name: match_commit
nodes.summary: Fetches a commit's diff via git_bridge, then for each changed line range finds overlapping node_provenance entries and inserts commit_lineage rows linking the commit to the provenance that produced those lines.

nodes.name: process_events
nodes.summary: Iterates a batch of tool-call events for a session, dispatching each edit event to process_single_event.

nodes.name: process_single_event
nodes.summary: Handles a single file-edit tool-call event: extracts the target file path from the event args, resolves the touched line range, and records provenance for it.

nodes.name: resolve_line_range
nodes.summary: Determines the start/end line range touched by an edit event, dispatching to resolve_replace_range or resolve_append_range depending on which args fields are present.

nodes.name: resolve_replace_range
nodes.summary: Computes the line range affected by an old_string/new_string replace edit by locating the old content's byte offset in the current file and counting lines.

nodes.name: resolve_append_range
nodes.summary: Computes the line range affected by an append-style edit based on the existing file's line count and the appended content's line count.

nodes.name: process_patch_event
nodes.summary: Parses an apply_patch-style multi-file patch, extracting per-file added/updated hunks and recording provenance for each touched file/range.

nodes.name: parse_hunk_header
nodes.summary: Parses a unified-diff `@@ -a,b +c,d @@` hunk header into a start/count line range.

nodes.name: count_patch_content_lines
nodes.summary: Counts the content lines belonging to a given target file within an apply_patch-style patch block.

nodes.name: get_commit_diff
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered commit-diff implementation (injected by the git integration layer) to fetch a LineageCommitDiff for a commit SHA, erroring if no implementation was registered.

nodes.name: LineageHunk
nodes.summary: A single diff hunk's new-side start line and line count.

nodes.name: LineageFileDiff
nodes.summary: Per-file diff entry: file path, binary flag, and its hunks.

nodes.name: LineageCommitDiff
nodes.summary: A full commit diff as a list of per-file diffs.

nodes.name: compute_node_hash
nodes.summary: Hashes code content (start_line..end_line) with SHA-256 after collapsing per-line whitespace, so formatting-only changes don't produce a new hash.

nodes.name: delete_session_lineage
nodes.summary: Deletes all commit_lineage and node_provenance rows tied to a session, since commit_lineage is keyed by provenance_id rather than session_id and needs an explicit cascade.

nodes.name: get_session_impact
nodes.summary: Async wrapper that runs analytics::get_session_impact on the blocking pool and serializes the result to JSON for the Tauri boundary.

nodes.name: get_provenance_session_ids
nodes.summary: Async wrapper that runs analytics::get_provenance_session_ids on the blocking pool.

nodes.name: record_provenance
nodes.summary: Reads the edited file, clamps the given line range to its length, hashes the content, finds tree-sitter symbols overlapping the range, and inserts a node_provenance row (plus one row per overlapping symbol).

nodes.name: init_lineage_tables
nodes.summary: Creates the node_provenance and commit_lineage tables and their indexes if they do not already exist.

nodes.name: check_branch_health
nodes.summary: Runs git existence/clean/merge-conflict checks against a branch and assembles a BranchHealthResult describing whether it is safe to resume orchestration on it.

nodes.name: git_branch_exists
nodes.summary: Runs `git rev-parse --verify` to check whether a branch exists in the repo.

nodes.name: git_is_clean
nodes.summary: Runs `git status --porcelain` to check whether the repo's working tree is clean.

nodes.name: git_has_merge_conflicts
nodes.summary: Checks the repo for unresolved merge-conflict markers via git status.

nodes.name: BranchHealthResult
nodes.summary: Outcome of a branch health check: existence, clean working tree, external modifications, and merge-conflict flags plus a details string.

nodes.name: orchestrator_start
nodes.summary: Tauri command that starts orchestration on a work item: guards against starting from a non-idle phase, snapshots agent config, and registers a new linked coding session.

nodes.name: orchestrator_cancel
nodes.summary: Tauri command that cancels an in-flight orchestration run for a work item via the state machine's cancel transition.

nodes.name: orchestrator_retry
nodes.summary: Tauri command that retries a failed or awaiting-user work item: re-checks branch health if a branch was recorded, then re-snapshots config and starts a new linked session.

nodes.name: orchestrator_get_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the current OrchestratorStatus (phase, retry count, interrupted flag, active-config flag) for a work item.

nodes.name: orchestrator_list_sessions
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing the linked agent sessions recorded on a work item's orchestrator state.

nodes.name: orchestrator_create_follow_up
nodes.summary: Tauri command that creates a follow-up work item from review feedback on a parent work item.

nodes.name: orchestrator_get_diff_stats
nodes.summary: Tauri command computing added/removed/renamed file stats between a work item's branch and its base branch.

nodes.name: orchestrator_set_pr
nodes.summary: Tauri command that records a PR URL and status onto a work item's proof-of-work frontmatter.

nodes.name: OrchestratorStatus
nodes.summary: Serializable snapshot of an orchestrator's current phase, retry count, interrupted flag, and whether it has an active agent config.

nodes.name: compute_diff_stats
nodes.summary: Runs `git diff --numstat` between base and work-item branches in a repo and parses the output into per-file diff statistics.

nodes.name: parse_numstat
nodes.summary: Parses `git diff --numstat` text output into structured per-file added/removed line counts, resolving rename paths and file status along the way.

nodes.name: parse_rename_path
nodes.summary: Parses git's `{old => new}` rename path notation out of a numstat path field.

nodes.name: determine_file_status
nodes.summary: Determines whether a changed file is added, deleted, renamed, or modified by checking its existence on the base and work-item branches.

nodes.name: file_exists_on_branch
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given path exists in the repo tree at a given branch via `git cat-file`.

nodes.name: create_follow_up
nodes.summary: Creates a new follow-up work item linked to a parent by short ID, copying forward relevant metadata and the review feedback that triggered it.

nodes.name: ensure_proof_of_work
nodes.summary: Returns a mutable reference to a work item's proof-of-work record, initializing it with defaults if absent.

nodes.name: set_pr
nodes.summary: Records a PR URL and status onto a work item's proof-of-work frontmatter; called from orchestrator_set_pr.

nodes.name: accumulate_cost
nodes.summary: Adds a session's cost and token usage to the work item's running proof-of-work totals; called when a linked session completes.
